draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.80, the 207th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 25th of 37 at CB. He went 68th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (207th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (16th percentile). College production: 3 passes defended in 2021, 27th of 31 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the New Orleans Saints. 50 career games and 33 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 3 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 5 AV in 2024 against a career-best 6 in 2023. Strengths in 2024: season snap share 76.5% (80th percentile), approximate value 5 (79th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 cornerback who played: 76.5% season snap share against a median of 40.4%, above the norm.
